# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen at school start in Avonlea; two years older than Anne Shirley; later a university graduate.  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c19 P44](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0044), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c40 P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025), [v3 c41 P15](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0015)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c38 P49](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0049)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher and university student  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Medalist  <sub>[v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>; President of the Freshman Class  <sub>[v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>; President of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society  <sub>[v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a handsome, tall boy with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a teasing smile. As he matures into manhood, he develops broad shoulders and a frank, manly countenance. After a severe bout of typhoid fever, he looks visibly thinner, paler, and older, having put boyhood behind him.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 c39 P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022), [v3 c41 P15](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0015)_

## Personality

Gilbert is cheerful, clever, and inherently ambitious, constantly determined to excel in his studies and make the best out of life. He possesses a droll sense of humor and loves to tease those around him, yet he is genuinely kind-hearted, courteous, and contrite when he causes offense. In his academic and personal life, he shows deep perseverance, strategic leadership, and high ideals.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)_

## Goals

- To earn his way through college and become a doctor  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013)</sub>
- To win academic honors and high standing at Queen's Academy and Redmond College  <sub>[v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v3 c9 P1](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0001)</sub>
- To earn the friendship and ultimate affection of Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v3 c20 P41](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0041)</sub>

## History

Upon returning to Avonlea school, Gilbert inadvertently sparked a long feud with Anne Shirley by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots', receiving a broken slate over his head in response. Despite his immediate and sincere apologies, Anne refused to speak to him or forgive him for years, sparking a fierce academic rivalry throughout their time at Avonlea school and Queen's Academy. After Gilbert won the Medal at Queen's, he surrendered his appointment as teacher at the Avonlea school so that Anne could remain close to home following Matthew Cuthbert's death, leading Anne to finally forgive him and initiate a close friendship. Gilbert went on to teach at White Sands while serving as president of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society before attending Redmond College to pursue a career as a doctor. At Redmond, he distinguished himself as freshman class president, joined the 'Lambs' fraternity, and earned high academic honors. During his sophomore year at Redmond, Gilbert confessed his love to Anne at Patty's Place, but she rejected his proposal, after which he respectfully retreated into a distant, polite friendship. Overworking himself in pursuit of honors and the Cooper Prize, Gilbert fell critically ill with typhoid fever after his junior year, but survived and resumed his warm comradeship with Anne.

## Background by volume

- Traveled to Alberta with his sick father for three years during his childhood, falling behind in school attendance  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Visited cousins in New Brunswick before returning to Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- Son of John Blythe, a former suitor of Marilla Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m awfully sorry I made fun of your hair, Anne. Honest I am. Don’t be mad for keeps, now.  <sub>[v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)</sub>

> I’ll never ask you to be friends again, Anne Shirley. And I don’t care either!  <sub>[v1 c28 P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)</sub>

> It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?  <sub>[v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)</sub>

> We are going to be the best of friends. We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you.  <sub>[v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)</sub>

> Friends! Your friendship can’t satisfy me, Anne. I want your love—and you tell me I can never have that.  <sub>[v3 c20 P41](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0041)</sub>
